agent_prompt:
CONTEXT:
- Project: NorthGuard — LLM prompt governance gateway (audit-grade evidence ledger).
- Tech: TypeScript, Node 20 ESM, strict; Vitest. See DECISION-REGISTER.md and AGENT-RULES.md.
- Current state: fresh core package; this is the first ledger story. Nothing depends on it yet, but everything will.
- AMENDMENT (DECISION-REGISTER §8 A2, NG-19): the ledger stores actorPseudonym + actorEpoch, NEVER a plaintext user id. This guard lands HERE, before any writer exists.

TASK:
Implement US-013: the append-only, hash-chained JSONL ledger writer (AF-401), including the NG-19 actor-pseudonym guard.

CREATE THESE FILES (see manifest.create): core/lib/types.ts (LedgerEntry with actorPseudonym?:string + actorEpoch?:number and NO `user` field, plus the contract types from specs/EP-01-gateway-adapter/EPIC.md), then SF-4011..4015 under core/src/features/ledger/append/, each with an adjacent .test.ts, plus index.ts.

FUNCTION SIGNATURES: exactly as in specs/EP-04-audit-ledger/APP-FUNCTIONS.md (AF-401 section) — loadChainTail, computeEntryHash, appendAtomic, assertNoPlaintextActor, appendLedgerEntry.

CHAIN ORDER: computeEntryHash → loadChainTail → appendAtomic → assertNoPlaintextActor → appendLedgerEntry.

RULES:
1. TDD: write the test first, watch it fail, then implement.
2. ONLY create files in this manifest. Do not touch protected paths.
3. TS strict — no any, no non-null assertions without proof.
4. NG-5: append must be atomic and survive process restart with no gap; a torn final line (crash mid-write) is ignored, not chained onto.
5. NG-19: appendLedgerEntry MUST call assertNoPlaintextActor before writing; an entry carrying a plaintext `user` (or any userId-shaped) field throws PlaintextActorError. Only actorPseudonym (+actorEpoch) is permitted.
6. computeEntryHash MUST be canonical (key order independent) so verifyChain (AF-406, later) can recompute it.
7. No network, no external services — this is a local file.
8. After each function+test pair, run vitest on that file and report.
9. When done, run all ledger tests and report a summary. Write two entries and assert entry2.prevHash === entry1.hash; assert an entry with a plaintext user id is rejected.
